message.reasoning_content:
Analyze: kernel uses A&S 7.1.26 approximation which has max abs error ~1.5e-7 on erfc... but applied with GELU multiplied by x, contract requires 1e-6 absolute throughout entire FP16 domain. Key risks: approximation error of A&S formula is ≤1.5e-7 for erfc, but here tail ~ 0.5*poly*envelope approximates Phi tail? Actually erf approx error |ε|≤1.5e-7, so Phi error ~7.5e-8; then value = x*P(x): for large x, P(x)≈1 and error in P times x could exceed 1e-6? For x large positive, 1 - tail approximates Phi(+|x|)? Wait: for x≥0, probability = 1 - tail where tail = 0.5*poly*envelope approximates 0.5*erfc(x/√2) = 1-Phi(x). Error in tail relative... A&S error is absolute ≤1.5e-7 on erf, so error in probability ~7.5e-8, times x up to 65504 → error up to ~0.005? Actually for large x, tail→0 and 1-tail→1, error in probability is error of the approximation for erfc which is bounded absolute 1.5e-7·0.5? A&S 7.1.26: |ε(t)| ≤ 1.5e-7, erf(x) ≈ 1 - poly·exp(-x²). Absolute error ≤1.5e-7 even where erf≈1. So Phi error ≤7.5e-8 absolute; multiplied by x=65504 → ~0.005 error potentially. But actually at large x the poly·envelope underflows to 0, giving exact 1; error only in mid-range where x·7.5e-8 ≤ ~1e-6 requires x ≤ ~13. Hmm, real erfc approx error is much smaller typically; but the risk is real: value error = x·ΔPhi can exceed 1e-6 for moderate x (~10-40). Also envelope exp(-x²/2) underflows to 0 for x>~38 (FP32 exp underflow below ~-87 → x>13.2 gives exp(-87)). Actually 0.5*x² = 87 → x≈13.2; beyond that envelope is subnormal→0, tail=0, probability=1, error = |1-Phi(x)|·x, tiny. Mid range x in [4,13] is the risk band.

Also negative x large: probability = tail which for x<-13 is 0 → value = x*0 = 0, but true GELU(-x)→0⁻, fine.

Also envelope computed with tl.exp in FP32; coefficients truncated (0.3276 vs 0.3275911, 5 coefficients) — the true A&S uses exactly these; fine.

Also signed zero: x=-0: x<0.0 false → probability=1-tail, tail=0.5*poly*1=0.5*poly(0)... poly at t=1: 1.06141-1.45315+1.42141-0.2845+0.25483 = 1.0000 → tail=0.5, prob=0.5, value=±0·0.5=±0 ok.

Note kernel uses Horner starting with 1.06141*t - 1.45315 — correct A&S form.
